mapper.select: SELECT parking_spot_id AS spotId, parking_log_id AS parkingLogId, parking_floor AS parkingFloor, parking_row AS parkingRow, parking_column AS parkingColumn, is_parked AS isParked FROM parking_spot WHERE is_parked = false ORDER BY parking_floor ASC, (parking_row + parking_column) ASC, parking_row ASC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE parking_spot SET is_parked = false, parking_log_id = NULL WHERE parking_log_id = #{parkingLogId}
